maya (docs): quick heads-up: i opened PR to reconcile structured-output examples with the new tool-invoke envelope. https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4721 please help with snippets & a tiny migration checklist.

dev (sdk): on it. i'll provide TS + PY snippets showing strict jsonschema validation and a permissive fallback helper. will avoid encouraging direct reads of legacy `function_call` shape.

harper (eng): runtime note: hosted uses invoke_v2; Dedicated clusters may still have compat disabled. docs need a clear `redwoodctl` toggle and the exact CLI flags. also watch KMS signing change for on-prem.

jun (ml): for parsing patterns, include an example of a nullable-array schema (e.g., `items: {type: 'array', items: {type: ['string','null']}}`) and a snippet showing defensive parsing. edgecases surface in regen tests.

maya (docs): good. i'll add a short "what to do on schema validation fail" section with sample log and suggested Sentry tags.

oliver (pm): partner demo next week. we need migration snippet (curl + redwoodctl), one-line ops command, and a short bullet about potential latency change when switching from compat.

dev (sdk): draft TS helper I'll push: ```ts
function safeFirstOutputText(resp, client){
  if (resp.outputs && resp.outputs.length) return resp.outputs[0].text ?? null;
  if (client.config.compatibility) return resp.function_call?.args?.text ?? null;
  return null;
}
```

harper (eng): wrap access to `function_call` behind `if (client.config.compatibility)` and mark it as a migration shim. also exact CLI: `redwoodctl cluster set-invoke-compat --cluster <name> --enable`. on-prem re-sign command: `redwoodctl tools resign-manifest --cluster <name> --manifest ./tools.json`. link support: https://redwood.ai/support.

jun (ml): QA: in regen tests we saw a case where `outputs: []` and `function_call` present but args empty. docs should call that out and provide troubleshooting steps (check signed manifests, runtime logs, and KV cache header absence).

maya (docs): noted. i'll change phrasing to "may surface cache hints in headers" instead of promising them. also sweep internal anchors (some moved to `#invocation-v2`).

dev (sdk): i'll run `docs-ci check-links` after updates. pushing a commit for nullable-array examples and the safe helper.
